question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Blissful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Joyful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Blissful"** means extremely happy or full of joy; a state of perfect happiness and contentment. (आनंदमय)

 
 
• **Example:** The couple looked blissful as they exchanged vows on their wedding day.
 
 
 
• **"Joyful"** means feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness. (प्रसन्न)
 
 
• **Example:** The children were joyful during the festival celebrations.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Blissful' **is **'Joyful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Joyful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bountiful **(भरपूर): Abundant or plentiful in quantity.

 
 
• **Example:** The farmer had a bountiful harvest this year.
 
 
 
• **Wishful **(इच्छापूर्ण): Having or showing a longing or desire for something.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a wishful glance at the dress she wanted to buy.
 
 
 
• **Frightful **(भयावह): Very unpleasant, shocking, or alarming.
 
 
• **Example:** The frightful storm caused extensive damage in the town.
